facts.text: Non-Arizona residents enrolled full-time in the BSN program can receive the Brookline BSN Merit Scholarship of $2,225 per semester based on entrance exam scores.

sources.title: FAFSA, Financial Aid, Grants, Loans & Scholarships
sources.quote: This merit-based scholarship is available for students enrolled in the BSN program at Brookline College who do not reside in Arizona and who have earned a score of 64 or above on the TEAS entrance test

sources.title: FAFSA, Financial Aid, Grants, Loans & Scholarships
sources.quote: The scholarship is awarded at $2,225 per full-time semester (12+ credits), up to $20,025. Students must remain continuously enrolled full-time and meet Satisfactory Academic Progress standards.
